blink.label: flash {s}

entered.label: is entered
entered.hint: Someone comes into the room, whichever sensor notices it

empty.label: becomes empty
empty.hint: Nobody there any more, after the set waiting time

coming_home.label: is getting close to home
coming_home.hint: Closer than 2 km (adjustable) and not moving away

heading_home.label: is probably coming home
heading_home.hint: Learned from earlier trips: starting place, weekday, time and direction

arrives_within.label: will be home in under {value}

moving_for.label: has been on the move for {value}

is_near.label: is on the way home

is_heading_home.label: is probably on the way home
is_heading_home.pl: is probably on the way home
is_heading_home.hint: With “everyone”, only those on the move count

is_moving_for.label: has been on the move for {value}
is_moving_for.pl: has been on the move for {value}

workdays.label: it is a workday

ask.label: ask {s}: “{message}”

alarm.label: warn {s} loudly: “{message}”

wait_until_empty.label: wait until the room is empty

fired.label: happens as “{event_type}”
